posts.cooked:
It's probably too late for me to get it ready by tomorrow (where I might need it) but that shouldn't discourage me starting a translation.

As you don't really need more than the rules infos on the character booklets it shouldn't be that much to do.

But if anyone has already done some translations for their own groups please let me know.

Current plan:

- Translate rule section

- Translate booklets of Legacy, Wraith, Tachyon, Absolute Zero

- Translate booklets of Bunker and Unity (more things to translate)

I'll keep you posted on my progress.
